program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-5688a9d1.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid[0])
    center = grid[0].index(2)
    out = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            distance = abs(c - center)
            if distance == r:
                out[r][c] = 2
            elif distance <= r and (c - center - r) % 4 == 0:
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(program_path), 'exec'), globals())
